common_resource_contract.coordinate_order: xy extents/coordinates; host/NumPy arrays are H,W,channel; half/word buffers little-endian.
common_resource_contract.allocation_vs_active: Normalized texture sampling uses that SRV resource allocation extent from GetDimensions. Motion UV-to-pixel scaling uses original active full-render Size.xy. These are distinct quantities.
common_resource_contract.grid_rule: Colour B4: max(1,floor(active_dimension/4)); Anchor B8: max(1,floor(active_dimension/8)).
common_resource_contract.crop_rule: Synthetic full allocation is explicitly known. For any optional real crop, report original render size and each crop origin; unavailable positive-weight off-crop taps are unsupported, never synthesized by clamping the crop.
common_resource_contract.hardware_sampler_vs_model: Ideal mathematical, explicit float32 source-shaped, and observed-device 8-bit-fraction models are different hypotheses. Fraction bits=8 nearest-even is a recorded-device approximation, not a universal D3D contract.
common_resource_contract.typed_conversion_scope: Record each actual resource format and conversion boundary. RTZ typed store, RNE half arithmetic/cast and f32tof16 are separately measured; do not infer one from another.
common_resource_contract.subresources: Only mip0, sample count1; array slice integer identity must be recorded.
common_resource_contract.format_support: Query SRV sampling/filtering and UAV typed-store support for each requested DXGI format on the actual adapter. A rejected format is a capability result, not an emulated pass.
common_resource_contract.upload: Preserve input payload bits through raw upload. Record tight input stride and actual placed-footprint row pitch, slice pitch and total bytes.
common_resource_contract.dispatch: Production entry points use numthreads(8,8,1); Dispatch(ceil(gridW/8),ceil(gridH/8),1). Padding threads must not write outside the active output grid.
common_resource_contract.custom_diagnostic_dispatch: For one-dimensional arrays use uint i=dispatch.x, numthreads(8,8,1), Dispatch(ceil(N/8),1,1), and return if dispatch.y!=0 or i>=N. Every local shader/root binding must be returned; these are requested operations, not compiled artifacts.

required_order: Create debug-enabled device and record hardware identity before PSOs.
Create correctly typed resources and separate immutable inputs for every A/B branch; zero unused cbuffer padding.
Upload initial bytes, transition COPY_DEST to NON_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE for SRVs; transition destinations to UAV.
Clear the entire requested counter/output range and record an ordered barrier before shader writes.
Set root signature, descriptor heap and CBV; record pass dispatches in stated order.
Insert UAV ordering barriers between dependent UAV writes/readers, and explicit UAV-to-SRV/COPY_SOURCE transitions where required.
Copy to readback resources with GetCopyableFootprints; submit; wait for the exact fence before mapping.
Retain upload resources, descriptor heaps, PSOs, CBVs and readbacks until their last GPU fence completes.
Strip row padding only according to the returned footprint and hash the logical payload.
common_startup_and_lifetime.debug_acceptance: No D3D12 debug errors or warnings, resource-state errors, descriptor-format mismatch, invalid array slices or GPU validation messages. Return the complete log, including empty-log evidence.
common_startup_and_lifetime.fixed_population: Freeze case IDs and all input-index masks before dispatch. Report all rows/cells and every changed branch; no candidate-derived exclusion or tolerance-based sample selection.
